verdict.rationale: Docusign Web Forms support conditional logic so 'only relevant fields appear' (docusign-docs-19) and CLM lets teams 'set conditional rules for things like review of non-standard terms' (docusign-docs-40), while AI-Assisted Review can 'flag potentially risky language' (docusign-docs-20). But there is no evidence of a founder-oriented guided questionnaire that assembles a specific legal document end-to-end or explicitly routes flagged clauses to attorney review — these features are enterprise CLM/forms tools, not a legal-document wizard. Missing for 10: an actual step-by-step questionnaire UI for common startup legal docs, explicit 'send to attorney' flagging workflow, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific use case.
